summary: Make https://ekodi.kr/ekodimall and https://ekodi.kr/ekodimall/admin the canonical public and admin surfaces for EKODI Mall, and register Mall as an independently managed responsible service that composes reusable capabilities.
approvalBasis: The platform owner explicitly instructed EKODI to continue with /ekodimall and /ekodimall/admin and to operate internal independent, common and professional services.
migrationPolicy: Use /ekodimall as the unique canonical Mall path. Historical /ekodibiz/ekodimall, /ekodibiz/mall and /mall paths may only hand off to the canonical root path during migration and must not own a second Mall UI.
serviceBoundary: Mall owns seller, product, assortment, order, customer-service and settlement operating records. System/common/professional services retain independent ownership and are consumed through registered capability contracts.
commercialAuthority: EKODIBIZ remains the commercial subject, merchant/operator and contracting authority for EKODI revenue activity under REV-001; technical service independence does not create a separate commercial subject.
authorityImpact: No permission expansion. Person + Workspace + Role + Capability remains authoritative and URL nesting does not grant access.
rollbackPlan: Revert the boundary/path commits through the guarded release lane, restore the prior canonical metadata with a new additive migration, and verify auth/admin/public flows before promotion.
